implementation_binding: Before panel construction or model contact, hash and seal the complete R2 panel builder, feature extractor, schedule materializer, paired-branch trainer, checkpoint writer, evaluator, prediction writer, analysis implementation, and independent replay verifier. Run only contract-declared synthetic smoke fixtures before training. The implementation package seal is a required execution input and must be complete before the first panel candidate or backbone load.

q_r1_run_contract.use: frozen head, optimizer, objective, event-stream, and computation recipe reference

q_r1_analysis_contract.use: measurement definitions and family order reference only

q_r1_panel_contract.use: same-family/template panel semantics and radius-matching reference

q_r1_completion_seal.use: sealed result disposition and rationale; no row-level outcomes are inputs

q_execution_addendum.use: normative schedule algorithm and executed checkpoint-precedence context

question: Conditional on a common SHAM-weight-1.0 history through step 80, what is the paired effect of changing only the late-stage auxiliary SHAM multiplier to 0.5 for steps 81-120?
claim_boundary: Late-stage treatment effect under the common SHAM-1.0 step-80 history on fresh worlds from the same four families and fixed templates. Not a full-course half-weight effect, novel-template/family generalization, or universal control law.

seed_derivation.operation: SHA-256 of UTF-8 label; first four digest bytes unsigned little-endian
seed_derivation.uniqueness: the 24 derived values are distinct and do not collide with the three Q seeds or twelve Q-R1 seeds
seed_derivation.collision_policy: fail before initialization if a collision exists with any prior Q/Q-R1 seed; no outcome-dependent replacement

paired_seed_design.pairing_unit: exact per-seed optimizer/head state at global step 80

common_history.source_recipe: sealed Q-R1 B-SHAM training recipe and event schedule semantics
step80_checkpoint_contains: AdamW state including moments and step counters

training_input_bindings.authority: the exact sealed Q-R1 training sources, re-bound here for the SHAM-only common prefix and both continuations
training_input_bindings.source_parity: verify every bound byte count and SHA-256 before materialization; no replacement source

branch_intervention.scaled_terms: same semantic and Brier auxiliary contributions as the inherited SHAM objective
branch_intervention.denominator: unchanged total active event count; identical in both branches

frozen_training_recipe.head: CompatibilityHead(2048, mlp, 128); 590081 trainable parameters
frozen_training_recipe.base_objective: cross entropy plus 0.25 multiclass Brier under frozen Q row semantics
frozen_training_recipe.precision: FP32 head/features; autocast and TF32 disabled

schedule_algorithm_binding.normative_algorithm: For each seed, build group_id-to-primary-row indices; sort group IDs lexicographically; for epoch 1..3 shuffle a copy with Python random.Random(seed + epoch - 1); partition in order into 40 batches of 256 except the final batch of 16; preserve primary row order within each batch; place each auxiliary event at the corresponding anchor slot in ascending primary batch order.
schedule_algorithm_binding.global_step_mapping: global_step=(epoch-1)*40+step_in_epoch; common prefix uses global steps 1..80; branches use global steps 81..120

schedule_and_execution.branch_execution_order: deterministically alternate 1X-first and HALF-first by seed index; execution order does not alter schedule

opening_order: construct and seal fresh panel and frozen feature cache
verify panel construction and branch schedule
seal all training states, checkpoints, telemetry, and schedule receipts
record the single held-out panel opening
evaluate all 120 cells and seal complete raw predictions
run the frozen analysis and independent replay

failure_semantics.resume: only from a hash-validated complete checkpoint including optimizer and RNG state
failure_semantics.branch_fork_mismatch: fail before any branch optimizer step
failure_semantics.missing_or_nonfinite_checkpoint: preserve artifacts and stop; no replacement seed or rescue branch
failure_semantics.evaluation_failure: preserve outputs; repair only an outcome-blind plumbing defect without changing sealed metrics or opening a second time

no_go: Q-R1 outcome/prediction input to training or panel selection
